source_planner.success: real Wall env.eval_state after executed MPC boundary; position xy distance < 4.5

fp32_reference_check: input reference_scores checked against recomputed FP32 with rtol=0, atol=1e-6; first-pool no-op and restore require exact equality

rank_disagreement.ties: exact zero sign is retained; one-side tie is disagreement, two-side tie agrees
rank_disagreement.aggregation: pool mean, then episode mean; episodes have equal weight

local_block_output_nmse.teacher_inputs: FP32 target-block inputs; no cumulative quantized activation drift
local_block_output_nmse.aggregation: encoder current/goal branches equally weighted; predictor rollout calls equally weighted; then pool/episode means

planner_score_nmse.denominator: the FP32 score pool denominator is fixed for each site/bit comparison
planner_score_nmse.aggregation: pool mean, then episode mean; episodes have equal weight

cost_rule: all allocations use exactly 3 encoder and 2 predictor W8 groups; W4/W8 logical costs are recorded per group
